name: Victoria Broderick
summary:
Victoria Isabel Broderick (born 1991 or 1992) is an American politician who is the member-elect of the United States House of Representatives for Tennessee's 4th congressional district. A member of the Democratic Party, she narrowly defeated Scott DesJarlais in an upset in the 2026 election.
Broderick served as county chair of Lincoln County, Tennessee, from 2022 to 2025.
